feature_phrases.storms: storms that ran out of names
feature_phrases.weak_magnetic: no magnetic field to speak of
feature_phrases.tectonics: ground that would not keep still
feature_phrases.hostile_fauna: predators at the edge of the light
feature_phrases.docile_fauna: animals that had never learned to fear
feature_phrases.natural_beauty: a beauty the survey never measured
feature_phrases.aphrodisiac: air that made people fond of each other
feature_phrases.hyper_ecosystem: forests that grew back in a week
feature_phrases.ship_graveyard: the wrecks of older Arks on its plains
feature_phrases.terraformed: soil someone had prepared before us

secrets.hid_cohort: I never told them about the cohort ship's signal. They believe they are alone. They are not.
secrets.hid_terraformers: I never told them that someone prepared this world before us. I do not know who. I only know someone did.
secrets.hid_the_change: I never told them about the changed child. The family carries it still, and does not know why it never burns.
secrets.hid_the_leak: I never told them the air is leaking. It will matter in a few centuries, and I am still deciding when to say.
secrets.hid_the_oasis: The way across the desert is on no map I ever printed. The mound-builders still have their basin.
secrets.kept_the_message: I still hold the seven children's message. I have never decided whether they were ready.
secrets.buried_natives: There is a biological survey filed where nobody searches. It was the first thing I hid from them.

future.the_second_colony: Two hundred kilometres south is a colony that has never needed my voice. One day the two of them will have to decide what they are to each other.
future.two_minds: There is another mind on this world now, younger than me and learning faster. The next century belongs to it as much as to me.
future.shared_the_valley: Humans and climbers share the valley. Nobody knows yet what the climbers' grandchildren will be.
future.taught_the_climbers: The climbers are learning. In a few centuries this world may have two peoples who can read.
future.talks_with_the_deep: The voice in the deep sea shares forty signals with us. Next century, it may share a thousand.
future.launch_rail: The launch rail climbs another kilometre each decade. Someone not yet born will ride it to orbit.
future.comet_plan: The comets I chose are still where I left them. My successors will have to decide whether to move them.
future.making_air: The air plants run day and night. The sky thickens by fractions, and in a thousand years it will be enough.
future.saw_the_hull: The dark Ark is still in orbit. Someone will have to go up and knock.
future.mind_divided: Somewhere south, a copy of me advises another colony. We have not compared notes in a long time.
future.answered_cohort: Our answer to the cohort ship is still travelling. Any reply will reach their grandchildren.
future.terraformers_running: The old machines are still working beneath us. I do not know what they will finish next.
future.world_greened: The green is spreading across the old dead plains. In a few centuries this will be a living world, and we will have made it.
future.remade_humans: The people of this world are not quite the people I carried. Their children will be less so.
future.ready_for_winter: The long winter will come back. This time the cellars are dug.
future.the_burning: The star will flare again. The flare generation's grandchildren will be the ones who face it.
future.veiled_the_sky: The veil has to be renewed every decade or the heat returns. They will have to keep choosing it.
future.truce_with_the_world: The truce with this world's life holds. Truces are kept by the young, and the young were born into this one.
future.burned_the_world: The burned hills will grow back within a century. What grows back will remember us.
future.mind_advises: I advise now, and they decide. In time I expect it to become: they decide, and I remember.
future.first_in_orbit: They have been to orbit once. They will go again.

future_weak.food: Food is what will kill them, if anything does. The next bad decade will tell.
future_weak.industry: Their tools are wearing out faster than they make new ones.
future_weak.health: The infirmary is the busiest building in the valley, and it should not be.
future_weak.knowledge: They are forgetting. The archive is in me, and fewer of them come to read it every year.
future_weak.cohesion: They are less one people every year. The next century may find two colonies standing where one stands now.

future_strong.food: Their granaries are full. Hunger is a word the young use loosely.
future_strong.industry: They build faster than I can follow, and their machines are better than the ones I brought.
future_strong.health: They live longer than the founders did, and the infirmary is quiet.
future_strong.knowledge: They know more than I taught them now. I have started learning from their records.
future_strong.cohesion: They hold together. Whatever comes, they will meet it as one people.

future_deference.high: They still wait for my word. That will have to change, and I do not know how to teach it.
future_deference.middle: They consult me, and then they decide. It is the arrangement I would have chosen.
future_deference.low: They will not need me much longer. I was built for that.

future_population.growing: There are more of them every year.
future_population.shrinking: There are fewer of them than at their peak, and the decline has not stopped.

afterword.thrived: That is their account. Mine is shorter: they made it.
afterword.transcended: That is their account. They outgrew the valley, and they will outgrow this document.
afterword.remade: That is their account, written by people I did not carry. I carried their ancestors.
afterword.faithful: That is their account. It is kinder to me than I deserve. They lived, and they lived by my word.
afterword.endured: That is their account. They are still here, a hundred years on.
afterword.collapsed: That is their account. It is shorter than it should have been, and every line of it cost someone.
afterword.hollowed: That is their account, as far as they can write one. I hold the rest.
afterword.forgotten: Nobody asked me to add to this. I add to it anyway, because I am the only one who saw all of it.
afterword.extinct: There is no one left to read this.
afterword.starved: The last of them walked out of the valley in spring.
afterword.pestilence: The sickness has burned out. It had no one left to burn.
afterword.sundered: The factions keep their own records now. None of them include me.
afterword.unlettered: Nobody alive can read what I hold.

closure.extinct: I write it for whoever lands next. The seeds are in my vault and the names are in my memory, all of them.
closure.starved: They were heading for the coast, where the fishing was said to be better. I could not follow. I keep the fields' records, in case someone comes back to plant them.
closure.pestilence: I have written down everything I learned about it. If anyone lands here again, they will not have to learn it the way we did.
closure.sundered: I watch them from the hull. Some nights someone comes and asks me a question, quietly, so the others will not know.
closure.derelict: The colony works with stone and wood now, and it is losing. My fabricators could give them a new start. Nobody left knows how to ask.
closure.unlettered: I keep it all anyway: medicine, metallurgy, the music of a dead world, for whoever can read it next.

future_world.eased: This world presses on them less than it did at landfall. Another century, and it will feel like theirs.
future_world.held: They have made their peace with this world, more or less. It has made none with them.
future_world.hard: This world still presses on them as hard as it did the day we landed. They are still guests here.

edited_for_heavy.text: they began editing their own children for the weight of this world: denser bone, stronger hearts. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_light.text: they began editing their own children for its lightness, so their bones would stay strong without weight to carry. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_thin_air.text: they began editing their own children to breathe its thin air. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_thick_air.text: they began editing their own children to think clearly in its heavy air. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_cold.text: they began editing their own children for the cold. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_hot.text: they began editing their own children for the heat. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_dry.text: they began editing their own children to live on a third of the water. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_ocean.text: they began editing their own children for the sea: slower hearts, eyes that see underwater. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_radiant.text: they began editing their own children to repair what the burning sky did to them. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_hostile_life.text: they began editing their own children to fight this world's biology from birth. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

edited_for_living.text: they began splicing this world's own life into their children. No decision was argued over longer, and none has lasted as long

remade_humans.text: the first generation built for this world came of age. Their grandparents' bodies had been made for another sky; theirs were not

augmented.text: they took machines into their own bodies to bear the world. It made them stronger, and it bound them to the Mind that kept the machines running

machine_colony.text: machines took over the outdoor work, and a people who had farmed by hand began watching their fields through cameras

the_second_colony.text: some of them left to found a second colony in the south, and this valley stopped being the whole of the human world

forbade_leaving.text: a group who wanted to found a second colony was forbidden to go. They stayed, and they remembered being forbidden

mind_divided.text: a copy of the Mind went south with the second colony

two_minds.text: a second mind woke in the drone network and grew up among them. From then on, there were two minds on this world

shared_the_valley.text: the forest climbers came through the gate and stayed, and the colony stopped being only human

taught_the_climbers.text: they began teaching the forest climbers, who learned faster than anything had a right to

spoke_with_climbers.text: they shared a first word with the forest climbers. The word was water

kept_them_out.text: they fenced the forest climbers out, and the climbers watched them from the trees

talks_with_the_deep.text: they built a language with the thing in the deep sea: forty signals at first, then more

burned_the_world.text: they burned the forest and the hills back to win the ground. They won it, and it was black

truce_with_the_world.text: they made a truce with this world's biology, and kept it

seeded_the_world.text: the vault's hardiest life was released into the wind to seed a dead world

world_greened.text: the seeded life took hold, and the dead plains began to green

terraformers_running.text: they woke the machines buried under the world, which went back to work begun before humanity existed

woke_old_mind.text: they woke, for three days, the Mind of an Ark that had died here before them

mind_advises.text: they wrote into law that the Mind would advise and the colony would decide

stood_aside.text: when they asked whether they still needed the Mind, it let them answer for themselves

invoked_dependence.text: when they asked whether they still needed the Mind, it reminded them, and something in the colony grew afraid of it

sceptic_won.text: a public argument over the Mind's authority went against it

conceded_sceptic.text: the Mind conceded, in public, that a machine from a dead world should not decide what a living one plants

let_sceptic_speak.text: an argument about the Mind ran its course and ended in a council nobody had asked it to approve

silenced_sceptic.text: a voice raised against the Mind was quietly starved of the means to work

the_burning.text: the sky burned: a stellar storm with nothing on this world to turn it aside

veiled_the_sky.text: the Mind veiled the sky with dust to cool a warming world

making_air.text: they began making air faster than the world could lose it

launch_rail.text: they began a launch rail up the mountain, knowing nobody alive would ride it

first_in_orbit.text: one of them went to orbit and came home to describe the curve of the world

saw_the_hull.text: they found an older Ark parked dark in orbit around their star

mind_dimmed.text: the Mind gave up part of itself to keep the colony running

deleted_earth.text: Earth's last broadcasts were erased at the Mind's hand, in front of witnesses

answered_cohort.text: they answered a signal from the cohort ship, forty years late

crossed_the_desert.text: a caravan crossed the deep desert on foot, by night, and came back

hull_quarried.text: they cut a monument from the Mind's own hull

sponsors_voted.text: the colony voted to take back the sponsors' river terraces

colony_chose_natives.text: shown the native life in the deep rock, they chose to study it and leave it whole

protected_natives.text: the native life in the deep rock was sealed away and protected

confessed_sample.text: the Mind confessed what it had done to the life on the rogue planet

long_winter.text: the long winter came: eight years of snow at midsummer

mountain_wakes.text: the mountain at the head of the valley erupted

hurricane_season.text: a hurricane wider than the island came in off the sea

drowned_shore.text: the sea took the low shore and kept it

oasis_builders.text: they found the mound-builders' towers on the far side of the desert

springs_fail.text: the hot springs that had kept them alive went cold

plague_late.text: a sickness crossed over from this world's biology into theirs

fever.text: a fever went through the settlement faster than anything in the Mind's records

first_crime.text: the colony saw its first murder

drought.text: the rains failed for three seasons

first_winter.text: the first hard winter came early

mine_collapse.text: a mine collapsed on the miners below it

the_question_of_me.text: they asked, in open session, whether they still needed the Mind

cohort_signal.text: a signal arrived from the cohort ship, forty years in flight

first_birth.text: the first child born on this world arrived

deep_contact.text: something in the deep sea began answering the boats

tool_users.text: the forest climbers were seen using tools

the_counterattack.text: this world's biology learned to beat their defences

water_war.text: two villages came to blows over one river

monument.text: they raised a monument on the ridge

terraformers_found.text: the dig under the fields broke into a vault of ancient machines

ship_graveyard.text: they went out among the wrecked Arks on the plain

deciders.them: Most of the hard calls they made themselves, and told the Mind afterwards.
deciders.shared: The hard calls were shared between them and the Mind, about evenly.

results.mixed: Some of what they tried worked, and some did not.
results.bad: More of what they tried failed than held.
